threshold_definition: First actual validation environment step observed at >=50% or >=80%; unreached is blank. No interpolation. Threshold mean/std condition on reaching; n explicitly reports reached count.
std_definition: Sample std ddof=1 across seeds; n=1 has blank std.
aulc_definition: Normalized trapezoidal integral over nominal validation checkpoints 10000..200000, no assumed step-zero score. Early AULC uses 10000..50000.
paired_definition: Challenger minus reference. Negative threshold-step delta is earlier; positive demo_reduction_fraction is fewer samples. Threshold differences only include seeds where both methods reached.
tiny_roundoff: Rates with absolute value below 1e-12 formatted as zero; training and metric definitions unchanged.
